Tony Ferguson is one of the most unique and beloved fighters in UFC history, known for his relentless pressure, unorthodox striking, elite cardio, and incredible toughness. After winning The Ultimate Fighter 13 in 2011, "El Cucuy" built one of the greatest winning streaks the lightweight division has ever seen, winning 12 consecutive UFC fights. Along the way, he defeated elite opponents such as Rafael dos Anjos, Kevin Lee, Donald Cerrone, Anthony Pettis, and Edson Barboza, capturing the interim UFC lightweight championship in 2017. His unpredictable style, dangerous submission game, and willingness to push an exhausting pace made him one of the most feared fighters of his era. For years, Ferguson's long-awaited matchup with Khabib Nurmagomedov became one of the biggest "what ifs" in MMA history. The fight was scheduled an unprecedented five times but fell through each time due to injuries, illnesses, and other circumstances. In 2020, Ferguson accepted a short-notice fight against Justin Gaethje instead of waiting for a title shot. Gaethje ended Ferguson's historic winning streak in a brutal battle, marking a turning point in his career. Despite continuing to face top competition, Ferguson struggled to regain his championship form as younger contenders emerged in the lightweight division. Even without winning the undisputed UFC title, Tony Ferguson's legacy is secure as one of the greatest lightweights to never become undisputed champion. His incredible winning streak, unforgettable wars, and fearless approach earned him immense respect from fans and fellow fighters alike. Ferguson's creativity, durability, and relentless fighting spirit made him one of the most entertaining competitors the sport has ever seen, ensuring that "El Cucuy" will always be remembered as a UFC legend. #tonyferguson #justingaethje #ufc #viral #moco_loco10
